name: Recreational Vehicle
description: A motor vehicle, minibikes included, designed to travel over unimproved terrain that the DMV has found unsuitable for the public way and ineligible for road registration, which is where an off-road electric dirt bike lands.

restrictions.rule: Designed to travel over unimproved terrain and not eligible for road registration; no limit on motor power or speed (Rhode Island General Laws §31-3.2-1)
Registered with the Department of Environmental Management for $25 a year, with a reflective identification number displayed (Rhode Island General Laws §31-3.2-2)
First-time buyers and riders under 16 must complete a safety course, and carry proof of it when riding off private property (Rhode Island General Laws §31-3.2-2)
Riders and passengers must wear an approved helmet with a face guard (Rhode Island General Laws §31-3.2-7)
Kept off roadways, shoulders and the rest of the highway right of way except to cross directly, and never within an interstate or freeway right of way (Rhode Island General Laws §31-3.2-7)
Riders under 16 may not cross a state highway, and riders 16 or 17 may cross only while carrying a driver's license (Rhode Island General Laws §31-3.2-9)
Not allowed in state parks or management areas
The motorcycle license law doesn't apply to it, and the DMV doesn't register it
